content:
For a cross-game overview of this perk, see Mister Sandman.

“Murder in the dark!”

**Mister Sandman** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increases the damage dealt by sneak attacks on any weapon equipped with a suppressor. Additionally, the bow, compound bow and crossbow are all considered silenced by default.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your silenced weapons do an additional 100% sneak attack damage. | 001D2490 | 
| ★ | 1 | Your silenced weapons do an additional 50% sneak attack damage. | 0004B258 | 

The name of the perk is in reference to The Chordettes 1954 song "Mr. Sandman."

Before update 58, Mister Sandman only worked at night.

- While the description suggests it works with any silenced weapon, it will only work on ranged weapons. [verified] 
- Before patch 1.6.4.60, the benefit of this perk varied based on its equip position relative to Covert Operative. [verified]
